About me
About

I’m a Bachelor of Management student at Universitas Negeri Malang (GPA 3.77) concentrating in Marketing Management. My focus is marketing strategy, consumer behavior, market research, and digital marketing.

I build these skills through practice. In my Digital Marketing course project, I worked as a marketing consultant. In P2MW UM 2026, I helped develop the SmartQuail Farm business concept. At KSPM, I work as a Research Analyst, which trains my data analysis and research.

Through committee work (Public Relations and Logistics) and competitions such as Investment Manager Program 2026, I learned to work in a team and decide based on data. I’m looking for an internship in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Development, or Market Research.
